target.founder: Andrea Rocchetto, Francesco Ceccarelli, Ciro Pentangelo

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $42M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Chips & Semiconductors. Range: $2.0B - $11.0B.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 18.4x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Ephos is a seed-stage semiconductor company that has raised €41.5M in EU funding plus $8.5M in seed capital. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public semiconductors peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private-sector peers including SambaNova Systems, Rebellions, and d-Matrix.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $42M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $104M. Peer-median anchoring references 3 same-sector, adjacent-stage private comparables: SambaNova at $11.0B, Rebellions at $2.3B, and d-Matrix at $2.0B. The median across these three is $2.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (18.4x median across the three public tickers) is not applicable, as Ephos does not disclose revenue.

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range. The low end sits at $88M (conservative stage-progression floor), the median at $1.2B, and the high end at $2.7B (reflecting the peer median plus upside). The disparity between stage-progression ($104M) and peer-median ($2.3B) reflects the high variance in seed-to-Series-A valuations within semiconductors. Key uncertainties include Ephos's revenue trajectory, the appropriateness of Series-A peer comparables for a seed-stage company, and whether the peer set's wide range ($2.0B–$11.0B) reflects genuine comparability or market exuberance.
